capture_tick_origin: GameTest tick zero after setting the initial Creative Motor speeds in each rig. The GameTests run in separate batches so the rigs cannot overlap.

consecutive_power.phases: Phase 0 samples before each power action. Phase 1 follows each adjacent redstone block placement or removal on ticks 3 through 6.

gearshift_two_sources.action: On tick 4 place a Gearshift in an empty gap between the two independently running motors and immediately power it. Record the signed theoretical RPM and dropped Gearshift item count. Lane 0 motors rotate with the same sign before reversal and conflict at reconnection. Lane 1 motors counterrotate and join without breaking the Gearshift.

gearshift_powered_placement.action: Put the neighboring redstone block in place during setup. On tick 4 use a Gearshift item against that support while both drives are independent. The GameTest uses a NeoForge FakePlayer and the normal item use-on-block path.

world: Fresh disposable GameTest world followed by a second run reopening that same world. All 246 captured rows matched.
